description: This Java source file defines the GZIPFilter class, which is a web filter responsible for compressing HTTP responses using gzip if supported by the client and enabled in system settings. It handles gzip compression requests, checks client capabilities, and interacts with global configuration properties.

classes.name: GZIPFilter
classes.description: A web filter class that compresses HTTP responses with gzip if supported by the client and enabled in global settings.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Processes the request and response, applying gzip compression if supported and enabled, wrapping the response accordingly.

methods.name: performGZIPRequest
methods.description: Wraps the request in a GZIPRequestWrapper if the request is gzipped.

methods.name: isGZIPSupported
methods.description: Checks if the client supports gzip encoding via the 'accept-encoding' header.

methods.name: isGZIPEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves the global system property indicating whether gzip is enabled.

methods.name: isCompressedRequestForPathAccepted
methods.description: Checks if the request path matches configured patterns for gzip compression.
